justifications.durability: tests/test_plan_todos.py:171 asserts write_state(text, state) == text against the document's own bytes, and logs/negative-control.log shows that assertion reddens when the guard is reverted, so the guard has a test that fails if it regresses.

justifications.fit: the guard follows the surrounding idiom of reckon/_plan_html.py:2052 and extends the adjacent comment with the declarations case, introducing no banned name.
